name: tinycast-tmdb
title: TMDB
description: Root-search provider for TMDB movies and TV shows, with a small extension-owned index and a daily-updated metadata store.
author: tinycast

scripts.update: npm run fetch-exports && npm run daily-update && npm run build-index && npm run build-provider
scripts.test: node test/smoke.mjs && node test/delta.test.mjs && node tinycast/test/sync.test.mjs && node tinycast/test/provider.test.mjs && node test/groups.test.mjs && node tinycast/test/wikipedia-provider.test.mjs && node test/popularity.test.mjs && node test/wikipedia-delta.test.mjs && node test/normalize.test.mjs && node test/loader.test.mjs && node test/release.test.mjs
